QS_RAIDER._comment: Enemy wave unit spawned by spawners.json QS_HOLD_THE_LINE_ASSAULT. Hunts the player party and the convoy; colliding with the convoy fires DAMAGE (see spawners.json Waves[].DAMAGE_ON_REACH), colliding with the party triggers COMBAT.

QS_CARAVAN_CONVOY._comment: The escorted target. SpawnType TOWER_DEFENSE is a provisional choice -- the three documented SpawnType values (TOWER_DEFENSE/HORDE_DEFENSE/HUNT_NEAREST) all read as hostile/aggressive-unit flavors and none is confirmed to support a neutral, player-friendly, pathing-to-safety unit (SPEC.md open question #5). Reaching its destination fires ReachTargetTriggers, which QS_HOLD_THE_LINE_START's ACTIVATE_ENTITY objective is wired against; CollideTriggers:DEATH means the convoy being destroyed en route should fail the quest, not just damage it.
